title: The Last Signal
description:
Deep Space Logs - Entry 4471. A probe goes silent for nineteen years, then sends one impossible word back to Earth. Original fiction, written and produced by AX Viral Content Lab. New entries regularly.

#scifi #shortstory #creepy #space #microfiction
